broadcast.title: Send Mass WhatsApp Broadcasts Without Fear of Number Blocking
broadcast.subtitle: Reach thousands of customers with peace of mind. Our system automatically manages send delays, varies wording per message, and rotates numbers to keep your WhatsApp account safe.
broadcast.trustBadge: Safe for Business Numbers • Natural & Gradual Delivery • Cost-Effective
broadcast.protectionTitle: 5 Smart Ways We Keep Your Number Safe
broadcast.protectionSubtitle: Purpose-built delivery protection designed to make promotional messages flow naturally, as if typed by real humans.
broadcast.layer1Desc: Automatically rotates greetings and synonyms (e.g. Hello, Hi, Good Day). Each customer receives unique wording so WhatsApp does not flag it as repetitive bot spam.
broadcast.layer2Desc: Shows an authentic 'typing...' status for a few seconds based on text length before sending. Each message appears organically typed on a mobile device.
broadcast.layer3Desc: Messages are sent with relaxed 3 to 7-second random intervals rather than in a sudden flood, keeping your sending pattern normal and trusted.
broadcast.layer4Desc: For newly paired WhatsApp numbers, daily sending limits scale up smoothly over time so your number develops strong sender trust without surprises.
broadcast.layer5Desc: Connect multiple WhatsApp numbers to split recipient lists evenly and automatically failover to standby numbers if a primary account hits its daily limit.
broadcast.playgroundSubtitle: Type alternative wording in curly brackets like {Option 1|Option 2}. Click randomize to preview how each customer gets a unique message.
broadcast.featuresTitle: Complete Tools to Power Your Business Campaigns
broadcast.featuresSubtitle: From importing customer numbers to scheduling sends and tracking deliveries.
broadcast.featureCsvTitle: Direct Contact Import from Excel / CSV
broadcast.featureCsvDesc: Upload thousands of customer numbers effortlessly. Incorrect formats are auto-cleaned and duplicate numbers are filtered out.
broadcast.featureTagDesc: Tag contacts into custom groups (VIP, Reseller, Leads) and send personalized promotions that convert.
broadcast.featureScheduleDesc: Schedule broadcasts to send during optimal business hours. Pause or resume sending anytime with a single click.
broadcast.featureAnalyticsDesc: Track exactly which messages were sent, delivered (double gray ticks), and read (blue ticks) in real time.
broadcast.ctaBoxTitle: Ready to Reach Thousands of Customers Safely?
broadcast.ctaBoxSubtitle: Sign up in minutes and send bulk WhatsApp promotions without worrying about number bans.
